scientific_integrity: Mathematical argument and exact-arithmetic checker included; variance formulas are analytic, not extrapolated from experiments. Common random sign correction is acknowledged as previously known.
scientific_limitations: Uniform random subsets of all Sylvester rows only; no claim for deterministic hierarchical ordering, non-dyadic matrices, or arbitrary orthogonal ensembles. Specialist Hadamard-trace literature is incompletely accessible.
title: Sharp worst-case variance inflation of unmodified Hadamard trace probes
